main.description: A person's own casting picks: which LLM model they'd assign to play each of the Fellowship of the Ring's nine walkers. One record per voter — the record key is always "self", so re-casting overwrites the previous ballot in place rather than creating a new one. Written and read by fellowshipcast (https://fellowshipcast.bisks.net).

casting.description: One entry per character this ballot has cast, at most one per character.

updatedAt.description: When this ballot was last written, as an ISO 8601 datetime.

character.description: The Fellowship member's id, e.g. "gandalf" or "frodo" — see fellowshipcast's CHARACTERS constant for the fixed list of nine.

model.description: The id of the LLM model cast in that role, e.g. "claude-opus" — see fellowshipcast's MODELS constant for the fixed list of options.
